LESSON: EXTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Extensive Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Extensive Reading. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which aspects can enhance understanding of a reading text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify appropriate language structures in a reading text
2. read given texts with appropriate pronunciation and intonation
3. appreciate the role of fluency in understanding texts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: EXTENSIVE READING
This lesson teaches Extensive Reading for Grade 9 GERMAN.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify appropriate language structures in a reading text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. read given texts with appropriate pronunciation and intonation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of fluency in understanding texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Extensive Reading using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Extensive Reading above.
2. Explain Extensive Reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Extensive Reading.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Extensive Reading with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Extensive Reading important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which aspects can enhance understanding of a reading text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify appropriate language structures in a reading text
2. read given texts with appropriate pronunciation and intonation
3. appreciate the role of fluency in understanding texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
